name: Portal Attachment Paths

meta.description: Global inlet: carries chat attachments (id, name, type, size) plus the sandbox path each upload is staged at into body['portal_attached_files'], which is forwarded to the Portal pipeline; the pipeline turns them into per-file notes so the model reads the full file with its tools instead of answering from RAG excerpts.

content:
# Portal attachment paths — global inlet filter (seeded by scripts/openwebui_init.py).
# Open WebUI v0.12.5 pops body["files"] AFTER the inlet filters run (middleware.py
# process_chat_payload), then drops "metadata" before POSTing an OpenAI-compatible
# connection (routers/openai.py generate_chat_completion). The Portal pipeline
# therefore never learns an upload exists on disk. This inlet carries each
# attachment (id, name, type, size) plus its sandbox path into a top-level
# "portal_attached_files" key, which v0.12.5 forwards verbatim. The pipeline
# turns each item into one "[Attached file … path …]" note. Stored uploads are
# <uuid>_<filename> under /app/backend/data/uploads (= /workspace/uploads in the
# code sandbox); very long filenames fall back to <uuid>.<ext>, so the path is
# best-effort and the id is authoritative. Do NOT set file_handler: the RAG
# retrieval path must keep its files.
class Filter:
    def inlet(self, body: dict) -> dict:
        files = body.get("files")
        if not isinstance(files, list):
            return body
        carried = []
        seen = set()
        for item in files:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue
            fid = str(item.get("id") or "")
            if not fid or fid in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(fid)
            name = str(item.get("name") or "")
            meta = item.get("meta")
            size = item.get("size")
            if size is None and isinstance(meta, dict):
                size = meta.get("size")
            path = f"/workspace/uploads/{fid}_{name}" if name else f"/workspace/uploads/{fid}"
            carried.append(
                {
                    "id": fid,
                    "name": name,
                    "type": str(item.get("type") or "file"),
                    "size": size,
                    "path": path,
                }
            )
        if carried:
            body["portal_attached_files"] = carried
        return body
